Order.meaning: A supplied order identity and explicit urgency and priority facts.

Message.meaning: A newly constructed message value; creation here performs no transport.

messageId.meaning: Message identity copied from the order.

currency.meaning: Currency text supplied by the mapping default.

UrgentFlag.meaning: An immutable urgent flag whose declared invariant requires urgent to be true.

UrgentRequired.meaning: The urgent flag must be true.

ExpressFee.meaning: The constant fee value 1000; selecting this target does not evaluate it.

OrderToMessage.meaning: Copy orderId to messageId and default currency to GBP; require the full declared target.

PartialMessage.meaning: Copy orderId when supplied; omit absent output without copying unrelated fields.

ChooseDeliveryFee.meaning: Prefer the express target when urgent, otherwise priority when priority, otherwise standard; never execute the selection.
